label: CROSS_VENUE_TEMPORAL_WALK_FORWARD_AND_REGIME_STABILITY_SPEC_LITERAL
provenance_caveat: Real OKX / Binance UM exchange data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence and must never be relabelled as such. Multi-year window 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00:00Z (32808 hourly bars/symbol). Acquisition stays CLOSED (Hyperliquid moving tail exhausted, earliest ~2026-04-21). Performance evidence only when produced by the full battery under this prereg.
objective: The C1-C20 program closed with a pooled NO_GO on the UNCONDITIONAL spec-literal next-open edge (C20 pooled CI spans 0; both venues negative). Before that edge is abandoned, C21 tests a pre-registered, decision-relevant follow-up question: is the NO_GO stable across time and crash regimes, or does a pre-specified fold/stratum survive multiplicity control with a positive spot leg and cross-venue concordance? This is a NEW hypothesis (temporal walk-forward + regime stability + conditional subset), not a rerun of C20's unconditional test.
binding_task: C21-T1: Quantify the temporal and regime stability of the spec-literal crash-rebound edge on two independent real venues, with a pre-specified multiple-testing correction and an honest pooled C21 verdict (STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET / NO_GO / UNDERPOWERED). Every number must come from a full decision-grade battery executed after this prereg; no config switching after results.

folds.definition: Pre-specified contiguous calendar folds over the fixed multi-year window; each fold is evaluated independently per venue.
folds.walk_forward: Expand folds cumulatively (2023 -> 2023+2024 -> ... ) and report the cumulative equity/spot-leg trajectory to expose regime dependence; no parameter fitting is performed (all params fixed by this prereg), so walk-forward here is sequential out-of-fold reporting, not a fitted model.

strata.definition: Pre-specified conditioning variables used ONLY for the multiplicity-controlled conditional-subset test. No data-dependent selection of strata.
strata.selection_rule: Fixed by this prereg; strata are evaluated for every venue-fold and pooled; no post-hoc stratum invention.

hypothesis.description: Under the C19-adjudicated spec-faithful entry rule (SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN), the crash-rebound spot edge is measured per temporal fold and per pre-specified regime stratum on two independent venues, with a pre-specified multiple-testing correction; C21 reports whether any stratum survives with cross-venue concordance or whether the C1-C20 NO_GO is robust.
hypothesis.selection_rule: Fixed by this prereg; no config switching after results.

multiplicity.family: 8 venue-fold tests (4 folds x 2 venues) plus a separate family for stratum tests

inference_plan.power: Minimum heavy-compute floor: 20000 bootstrap draws and 20000 permutation draws and 2000 placebo subsets per venue-fold; a stratum/fold is only eligible for STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET if effective N >= 10 trades, >= 5 episodes, >= 5 distinct crash days. If unmet, the fold/stratum is UNDERPOWERED and a power curve must be reported.

decision_rules.stable_positive_subset: C21 STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET (provisional, follow-up warranting; NOT a global GO) only if at least one pre-specified venue-fold OR pooled-fold stratum survives BH correction at alpha=0.05 with episode-block bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 and positive spot leg, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical<0.05, and effective N >= 10 trades / 5 episodes / 5 crash days, AND the same-direction effect is present in the other venue (cross-venue concordance) OR is explicitly flagged single-venue exploratory.
no_go: no pre-specified stratum survives BH correction
pooled C21 venue-blocked bootstrap CI spans 0
spot leg non-positive across the majority of folds in both venues (corroborates C1-C20 NO_GO)
underpowered: per-fold effective sample below floor for all folds
missing seed/SHA binding or compute predating this prereg
decision_rules.report_both: Always report the per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve; never a bare token.

required_artifacts.handoff: HANDOFF.md must reference C21-T1 and verify_c21_focus_campaign.py

guardrails: No cross-venue relabeling as Hyperliquid-native evidence (is_hyperliquid_venue_data=false).
No synthetic gap-fill presented as verified.
No spec relaxation to manufacture a GO; SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN is the fixed reading.
No post-hoc stratum invention; strata and folds are fixed here before compute.
No silent change to the canonical baseline; C1-C20 NO_GO stands unless C21 produces a pre-registered contradiction with full evidence.
C21 is executable on already-verified real archives; acquisition stays CLOSED (no new-venue download, Hyperliquid tail exhausted).
